definition: A variable stores or refers to a value that a program can use.
A data type describes the kind of value represented by data.
A string is a sequence of text characters.
Integers represent whole-number values in programming.
A boolean represents a logical true or false value.
An array is an ordered collection of values accessed by position.
A list is an ordered collection that can contain multiple values.
An object groups data and behavior or represents a structured value.
A dictionary stores key-value associations.
A function is reusable code that can receive inputs and produce an output or side effect.
A parameter is a named input defined by a function.
An argument is a value supplied when calling a function.
A condition is an expression evaluated to decide which code path should execute.
An if statement executes code when a condition is true.
A loop repeatedly executes a block of code.
A for loop commonly iterates through items or a sequence.
A while loop repeats while a condition remains true.
A class defines a structure from which objects can be created.
Inheritance allows one class or type to derive behavior or structure from another.
An exception represents an error or unusual condition that interrupts normal execution.
Debugging is the process of locating and fixing software problems.
An algorithm is a defined sequence of steps for solving a problem.
A data structure organizes data to support efficient operations.
Recursion occurs when a function directly or indirectly calls itself.
An API defines how software components communicate.
An HTTP request asks a server to perform an operation or return a resource.
JSON represents structured data using objects, arrays, strings, numbers, booleans, and null.
Frontend code runs in or controls the user-facing part of an application.
Backend code handles server-side logic, data, APIs, authentication, and other services.
HTML structures content on a webpage.
CSS controls the presentation and layout of HTML content.
JavaScript is a programming language commonly used for interactive web applications.
Python is a general-purpose programming language known for readable syntax and a large ecosystem.
SQL is used to query and manipulate relational database data.
Git is a distributed version control system used to track changes to files.
Software testing checks whether software behaves according to requirements.
A unit test checks a small isolated part of a program.
An integration test checks how multiple components work together.
Algorithmic complexity describes how resource usage changes as input size grows.
